title: Why might world-model capability become concentrated?
summary: Compute, simulation infrastructure and scarce action-labelled data favour incumbent operators.
body: Advanced world models depend on large compute budgets, simulation infrastructure and scarce action-labelled interaction data. Organisations already operating robots, fleets or sensor-rich systems can accumulate proprietary experience that is difficult for smaller competitors or public institutions to reproduce.
